children: Director Ramin Kamfar reported purchasing 90,000 common shares of beneficial interest on November 16, 2026, at a weighted average price of $12.1967 per share through the Cypress Family Trust, Cypress 2022 Trust and Cypress WY Holdings, LLC, entities he controls. He reported purchasing 81,451 shares on November 17 at $12.1001 per share and 94,403 shares on November 18 at a weighted average price of $12.0867 per share through those entities. The total purchase amount was $3,224,289. Following the transactions, Kamfar indirectly owned 3,335,274 shares through entities controlled by him.
